## Outcome

What user or maintainer outcome does this change create?

## Public boundary

- [ ] Local-only and loopback-only behavior is preserved.
- [ ] No target code execution or GitHub mutation was added.
- [ ] No telemetry, AQA runtime endpoint, hidden destination, or silent provider fallback was added.
- [ ] New data disclosure is visible at the Context Pack approval gate.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Ruff check and format pass.
- [ ] No-AQA-runtime verification passes.
- [ ] Documentation and versioned method/schema constants are updated where needed.
- [ ] Fixtures contain no client data, credentials, private links, or provider payloads.

## Security and privacy notes

Describe any change to credentials, Git/GitHub, browser security, provider payloads, context selection, redaction, persistence, logs, exports, or deletion.
